name: BetterMe
description: Wellness and fitness app brand (Well-Being Coach app, Wall Pilates, Calisthenics, meal plans) running an affiliate program through Impact.com for health, fitness and personal-development creators.

evidence.summary: BetterMe's official affiliate announcement states the program runs through Impact.com, the commission rate starts at 15% with bonuses for top performers and a 30-day cookie, and 'as a BetterMe Affiliate, there's no cap on how much you can earn' - the cap is verified uncapped on the brand's own wording; the 15% starting rate is recorded.

The same official article recruits partners with a blog or social media following related to health, fitness or personal development, supplies unique affiliate links and promotional materials, and describes the Well-Being Coach app, customized workout plans and nutrition guidance affiliates promote.

reasons.niche_fit: A mainstream wellness/fitness app with workout and nutrition programs is a core UGC creator niche, and the program explicitly targets health and fitness creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A public program article recruiting bloggers and social creators with links and promotional materials supplied; no creator counts were published on the fetched page.
reasons.compensation: Verified uncapped earnings with a 15% starting rate that rises with performance, plus top-performer bonuses.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through Impact.com; no public program email was published on the fetched page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through Impact; the brand looks for an established online presence.
reasons.credibility: Established, widely distributed wellness app brand running its program on a major network (Impact).

name: Supergut
description: Gut-health food brand selling prebiotic fiber shakes, bars and mixes, running an affiliate program through Awin for gut-health and wellness creators.

evidence.summary: Supergut's official affiliate page states affiliates apply via its AWIN program, earn a minimum 10% commission (often more) on purchases through their link or code, and 'There is no limit to how much you can earn' - the cap is verified uncapped on the brand's own wording; the 10% minimum rate is recorded.

The same official page offers affiliates free products, unique discount codes and early access to promos and launches, says publishers can promote on any social network including Instagram and TikTok, and notes most active publishers receive first payments 30 days after the initial sale.

reasons.niche_fit: Gut-health shakes and bars are a proven wellness-creator category, and the brand frames affiliates as gut-health partners.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A public affiliate page with free product and discount codes for audiences; no creator counts were published on the fetched page.
reasons.compensation: Verified uncapped with a 10% minimum rate that is 'often more' - solid, though the exact uplift is unpublished.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through Awin; no public program email was published on the fetched page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application via Awin with brand approval.
reasons.credibility: Established gut-health brand with a network-run program and published payment terms.

name: Party Pump
description: Snack brand selling plant-protein cashew butter Squeezies pouches and jars in dessert flavors, running a tiered creator affiliate program with a free welcome kit.

evidence.summary: Party Pump's official affiliate site states base commission starts at 10-15% on every sale through a link or code, performers climb tiers to 20-25%+, and 'There's no cap - your earnings scale with your effort' - the cap is verified uncapped on the brand's own wording; the 10% starting rate is recorded.

The same official site is built for creators: approved affiliates receive a free Squeezie sample 4-pack with free shipping, a 30% first-order code, plug-and-play photos, video clips and captions, a real-time dashboard, 30-day cookie and monthly PayPal/Venmo payouts over $50, with approval usually within 48 hours and micro-creators explicitly welcomed.

reasons.niche_fit: Protein snack pouches are a natural fit for fitness, busy-mom and foodie creators, the exact audiences the program names.
reasons.ugc_evidence: One of the most creator-complete offers found: free product kit, creative assets, campaign briefs and monthly content competitions.
reasons.compensation: Verified uncapped; 10-15% starting tier climbing to 25%+ at the top tier.
reasons.contact_access: Application form on the official affiliate site (Social Snowball); no public email was published on the fetched page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application, approval usually within 48 hours, no follower minimum stated.
reasons.credibility: Small, founder-led snack brand; the program is detailed and current, but the brand's scale is modest, so held at 3.

name: Alcami Elements
description: Wellness brand selling mushroom and herbal blends (Smart Latte, Matcha, Cacao and Coffee, shilajit) running an affiliate program open to influencers, athletes, coaches and customers.

evidence.summary: Alcami Elements' official affiliate page states affiliates earn 15% commission on every purchase through their link or code, audiences get 20% off, and 'There's no cap on your potential earnings!' - the cap is verified uncapped on the brand's own wording.

The same official page says the program is open to influencers and content creators, athletes, wellness bloggers and coaches with no minimum follower count, supplies branded images, banners and product videos plus dedicated support, and notes it is accepting a limited number of affiliates - a cohort limit, not a published creator count, so saturation is recorded unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Mushroom/herbal drink blends sit squarely in the wellness-creator niche, and the page names creators, athletes and coaches.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Public program page with branded assets, product videos and a chance to be featured on the brand's social media.
reasons.compensation: Verified uncapped 15% commission with a 20% audience discount to drive conversion.
reasons.contact_access: Application form on the official page (partners portal); no public program email was published on the fetched page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Application with selection - the brand states it is accepting a limited number of affiliates.
reasons.credibility: Smaller premium wellness brand with a detailed, current program page; held at 3 for scale.

name: World's Best Nutritionals & Organics
description: Supplement brand selling whole-food, organic-ingredient vitamins and supplements, running a lifetime-attribution affiliate program paying 30% on every referred order.

evidence.summary: The brand's official affiliate page states affiliates earn 30% commission on every qualifying purchase a referred customer ever makes, with lifetime attribution and no expiry, and repeats 'No cap' in three places, including 'Forever. No tiers, no expiry, no cap.' - the cap is verified uncapped on the brand's own wording.

The same official page describes free sign-up at its affiliate portal with a referral link ready on registration, sharing via social media, email and messages, monthly payment, and program terms (self-referrals excluded; status can be revoked for misrepresentation). Its 'Most Lucrative Affiliate Program in History' headline is marketing language and is not treated as evidence of scale.

opportunity.title: World's Best Nutritionals & Organics Affiliate Program

reasons.niche_fit: Whole-food supplements fit health-creator content, though the program is framed for general referrers rather than creators specifically.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A public affiliate page with instant link issue; no creator program materials or creator counts were published on the fetched page.
reasons.compensation: Verified uncapped 20-point maximum: 30% on every order, for life, via permanent attribution - the highest rate in this batch.
reasons.contact_access: Sign-up through the brand's own affiliate portal; no public program email was published on the fetched page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free, instant registration with no purchase required.
reasons.credibility: Held at 2: the page's superlative marketing claims ('most lucrative in history', 'ground-floor rate locked in forever') could not be corroborated on the fetched page.

opportunity.title: Amyra Farms Refer & Earn Affiliate Program

name: NuKine Wellness

evidence.summary: NuKine's official affiliate FAQ pays 15% commission on the total sale for any and all products, answers 'Are there any limits to how much commission I can earn?' with 'No', and states 'There's no limit to the amount you can earn as a NuKine affiliate' - the cap is verified uncapped on the brand's own wording.

The same official page says tracking runs through its affiliate network partner UpPromote with a 30-day cookie and monthly PayPal payouts, the program is free, affiliates may earn on their own purchases, and applicants must be at least 21 with sales/shipping only inside the US where kratom is legal; the page also notes its products are not FDA approved and affiliates may not make medical claims.

reasons.niche_fit: A narrow botanical-wellness niche - strong for kratom/alternative-wellness creators, irrelevant for most others, so scored mid-range.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A detailed public FAQ recruiting influencers, podcasters and bloggers, with content available on request; no creator counts were published.
reasons.compensation: Verified uncapped 15% on all products with recurring 30-day cookie credit.
reasons.contact_access: Application via UpPromote from the official page; no public program email was published on the fetched page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Application with team review; 21+ and US-sales only.
reasons.credibility: Operating brand with complete program terms; the category's regulatory sensitivity (noted on its own page) holds credibility at 3.

reasons.ugc_evidence: A public program page naming creator types and offering real-time tracking; no creator counts were published on the fetched page.
reasons.compensation: Verified uncapped, but the rate itself conflicts across the page (10% / 15% / 15-30%), so compensation is scored on the unsettled rate.
reasons.contact_access: Published hello@optimalbreathing.com email and a street address on the official page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free application with team review; global where its affiliate software supports the country.
reasons.credibility: Established wellness brand with a physical address, published contacts and social profiles; held at 4.

name: Doorstep Meals
description: Prepared meal delivery service running a Diamond Affiliate Program where affiliates earn a flat $7 per follower order after the first 24 orders each month.

evidence.summary: Doorstep Meals' official affiliate FAQ states 'Is there a maximum I can earn? There is no cap to your earning potential in the Doorstep Meals Affiliate Program' and describes 'an unlimited income stream' - the cap is verified uncapped on the brand's own wording. Pay is a flat $7 per order placed by a follower after the affiliate's initial 24 orders in a month (not a percentage), so commission_rate is recorded null.

The same official page says affiliates receive promotional material, their own link and promo code and the ability to give first-time customers a free meal, recurring orders count toward the monthly threshold, and deposits are made on the 15th of the following month through PayPal.

reasons.niche_fit: Ready-made meal delivery is a strong food/lifestyle creator category with an easy free-meal hook for audiences.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A public affiliate FAQ with promo codes and a free-meal offer for first-time customers; no creator counts were published on the fetched page.
reasons.compensation: Verified uncapped, but flat $7 per order and only after 24 orders in a month - modest economics, scored accordingly.
reasons.contact_access: Contact route is via the affiliate page itself (the page's contact email was masked in the fetched copy and is not recorded); no public program email could be verified.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Create an account to receive a shareable link; Diamond status brings a direct customer-service contact.
reasons.credibility: Operating meal-delivery service with published payout timing; held at 3.
